title: Standard affine opens of Proj
statement:
Let $R=\bigoplus_{n\geq0}R_n$ be an $\mathbb N$-graded commutative ring, and let $R_+=\bigoplus_{n>0}R_n$ be its irrelevant ideal. For $a\in R$, write $D_+(a)=\{\mathfrak p\in\operatorname{Proj}(R):a\notin\mathfrak p\}$, regarded as an open subscheme of $\operatorname{Proj}(R)$ [def-nagata-affine-proj]. Each homogeneous $f\in R_d$ with $d>0$ determines a canonical isomorphism
$$
D_+(f)\cong\operatorname{Spec}(R_{(f),0}),
$$
where $R_{(f),0}$ is the degree-zero homogeneous localization [def-nagata-homogeneous-localization-degree-zero]. If a family $(f_i)_{i\in I}$ of elements of $R$ generates an ideal containing $R_+$, then the $D_+(f_i)$ cover $\operatorname{Proj}(R)$. No homogeneity or degree condition is required on this covering family.

blueprint_update.statement:
Each homogeneous $f$ of positive degree determines an open subscheme
$D_+(f)\subseteq\operatorname{Proj}(R)$ and a canonical isomorphism

$$
D_+(f)\cong\operatorname{Spec}(R_{(f),0}).
$$

If a family $(f_i)$ of elements of $R$ generates an ideal containing the
irrelevant ideal $R_+$, the $D_+(f_i)$ (the loci of homogeneous primes not
containing $f_i$) cover $\operatorname{Proj}(R)$.

proof.text:
The standard-open isomorphism is `Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec`.
The cover assertion is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.iSup_basicOpen_eq_top`; its hypothesis
that the chosen homogeneous family generates the irrelevant ideal is the
assumption in the statement.
Thus no independently glued affine scheme is being used.
